notes.title: VERTIGO! is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are very excited to announce that Vertigo! is available now on Steam for VR, and you can get it [b]15% discounted for the first week[/b]!

The porting process from Rift is complete, and you can finally play the game on HTC Vive as well.

KR Games team

notes.title: VERTIGO! Coming soon!
notes.notes:
We are excited to officially announce our new hang gliding simulator for VR, a game that will allow you to fly in complete freedom on a 8 km2 city ground, making breathtaking routines, experimenting acrophobia, and much more!

Available in [b]early May[/b] on Steam for HTC Vive and WMR. Stay tuned! 🚀

KR Games team
